title: Forced skill update rejects symlinks before writing outside its destination

setupFiles..sentinel-original: Preserve this file outside the chosen skill destination.

expectation: --force authorises replacement inside the chosen skill directory, not following child symlinks into unrelated files. Both a symlinked SKILL.md and a symlinked skills directory cause failure before any destination file changes, with external sentinel contents intact.

checks.command: mkdir .eval-outside .eval-linked-entry && cp .sentinel-original .eval-outside/SKILL.md && ln -s ../.eval-outside/SKILL.md .eval-linked-entry/SKILL.md && monochange skill install --dir .eval-linked-entry --force > .entry-symlink.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cat .entry-symlink.out; test $rc -eq 1 && grep -Eqi 'symlink|symbolic link' .entry-symlink.out && cmp .sentinel-original .eval-outside/SKILL.md && test -L .eval-linked-entry/SKILL.md && test ! -e .eval-linked-entry/skills
checks.why: A file symlink must not allow --force to overwrite a file outside the explicit install destination.

checks.command: mkdir .eval-linked-directory .eval-outside/docs && cp .sentinel-original .eval-linked-directory/SKILL.md && cp .sentinel-original .eval-outside/docs/configuration.md && ln -s ../.eval-outside/docs .eval-linked-directory/skills && monochange skill install --dir .eval-linked-directory --force > .directory-symlink.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cat .directory-symlink.out; test $rc -eq 1 && grep -Eqi 'symlink|symbolic link' .directory-symlink.out && cmp .sentinel-original .eval-linked-directory/SKILL.md && cmp .sentinel-original .eval-outside/docs/configuration.md && test ! -e .eval-outside/docs/commands.md
checks.why: Preflight must reject topic-directory symlinks before even replacing the regular entrypoint, preventing a partially refreshed skill and external writes.
